landmarks.name: Red Square
landmarks.writeup: Historic square in Moscow, known for its political and cultural significance.

landmarks.name: Kremlin
landmarks.writeup: Fortified complex in Moscow that serves as the official residence of the President.

landmarks.name: Hermitage Museum
landmarks.writeup: One of the largest and oldest museums in the world, located in Saint Petersburg.

landmarks.name: Lake Baikal
landmarks.writeup: World's deepest freshwater lake, located in Siberia.

landmarks.name: Saint Basil's Cathedral
landmarks.writeup: Iconic colorful cathedral located on Red Square in Moscow.

cultural_events.name: Maslenitsa
cultural_events.writeup: Traditional Slavic festival marking the end of winter with pancakes and festivities.

cultural_events.name: Victory Day
cultural_events.writeup: Commemoration of the victory over Nazi Germany in World War II, celebrated on May 9.

cultural_events.name: White Nights Festival
cultural_events.writeup: Cultural festival in Saint Petersburg featuring music, ballet, and opera during the summer.

food_writeup: Russian cuisine features hearty dishes like borscht, pelmeni, blini, and caviar, reflecting its diverse climate and cultural influences.
brief_history: Russia emerged as a powerful state in the 16th century, expanded across Eurasia, became the Soviet Union in the 20th century, and is now a federal semi-presidential republic.
current_conflicts: Ongoing tensions and conflict related to Ukraine, including the annexation of Crimea and military involvement in Eastern Ukraine.
